title: Bed assignment & occupancy flip
description: Assigning a tenant to a bed during onboarding flips that bed to OCCUPIED and prevents double-assignment.
acceptanceCriteria: An already-occupied bed cannot be selected during onboarding

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Building alongside LODGY-12 - see that ticket's note. The bed picker only ever queries VACANT beds, so occupied ones are never rendered as selectable in the first place (structural prevention rather than a validation check).

AgreementFormViewModel.save() calls bedRepository.setOccupied(bedId) in the same coroutine as creating the TenancyAgreement, so the write lands before the wizard pops back - BedGridScreen (LODGY-9) reads beds via a live Flow, so re-opening that room's bed grid afterward correctly shows OCCUPIED with no stale cache. AC2 is enforced structurally: BedPickerViewModel only ever collects beds with status==VACANT into its option list, so an occupied bed is never rendered as a selectable row in the first place, not just blocked after the fact. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, same as LODGY-12 (built together). On-device pass queued - specifically worth checking that the bed grid actually flips after completing onboarding, not just trusting the Flow theoretically works.

PASS - onboarded Ravi Kumar onto Room 101/Bed A, then immediately opened Room 101's bed grid: Bed A showed OCCUPIED, no stale cache (AC1). Started onboarding a second tenant right after: the vacant-bed picker no longer listed "Room 101 - Bed A" at all - confirmed structurally unselectable, not just blocked after picking it (AC2).
